description: Partha Majumdar publishes an educational notebook that turns historical inpatient encounters into a privacy-aware hospital planning report. It uses the public UCI Diabetes dataset covering 1999–2008, retaining one deterministically selected encounter for each of 71,518 patients. The notebook adds noise to bounded counts, bed-day totals and stay histograms, then derives workload summaries and a 1,000-admission scenario. The September 2026 IPYNB download is free under CC BY 4.0. It can illustrate uncertainty propagation and aggregate reporting in hospital-capacity simulations. Results concern a selected historical cohort, not current demand; the provider explicitly distinguishes pathway event volume from clinical risk. Production security and persistent privacy accounting remain unresolved. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this notebook. Code was not executed, and its stated mathematical privacy guarantee was not independently audited.
